data.question: I'm frustrated by lack of progress, not laziness. Will this actually help?
data.answer: Look, a book won't magically fix everything. But this volume gives you the foundational mindset and professional attitude that makes real progress possible. It helps you understand the 'why' behind productivity and success in software development.

data.question: I don't have time for a 100-page book...
data.answer: Fair enough. The chapters work as standalone resources. You can jump to specific topics when you need them, and there are external links for going deeper. Start with what's relevant to you right now.

data.question: Will this teach me technical skills?
data.answer: Not really. This volume focuses on mindset, professionalism, and the psychological side of software craftsmanship. There are practical examples, but it's about developing the right attitude and approach that makes you effective with any technology.

data.question: What if I don't like it?
data.answer: Email me within 14 days for a full refund. I just ask for a quick note about what didn't work for you so I can improve. No hassle.

data.question: What's actually in this volume?
data.answer: Software craftsmanship fundamentals: professional mindset, productivity techniques, understanding development roles, career progression, and the psychological aspects of being an effective developer. Check dev-concepts.dev for the full chapter breakdown and free samples.

data.question: Should I get the bundle instead?
data.answer: If you also want Volume 2 (client needs, UX design, requirements discovery), the Starter Bundle saves you 25%. Together they cover the two biggest gaps I've seen hold junior developers back.

data.question: Will there be more volumes?
data.answer: Yes, this is part of a 12-volume series. New volumes come out every few months. Check dev-concepts.dev for the Lifetime Bundle if you want all of them as they're released.

data.question: I can't afford this right now...
data.answer: Reach out to me via Twitter or email. I want to help developers grow regardless of their financial situation. We'll figure something out.

data.question: Can I buy this for my team?
data.answer: Absolutely. Contact me for group pricing. It's a great way to onboard junior developers or establish a shared professional mindset across your team.
